name: core.openwop.workflows.incident-postmortem
description: Incident-postmortem chains (RFC 0013): after an incident resolves, draft a blameless postmortem from the timeline and turn its action items into tracked tasks. Draft-first (the human edits before anything is shared). Replay-deterministic.
author: openwop

chains.label: Incident → Blameless Postmortem Draft
chains.description: When an incident is marked resolved, draft a blameless postmortem (summary, timeline, root cause, impact, action items) for the human to edit — as a saved draft, not an auto-send.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: Write a BLAMELESS postmortem from this incident timeline. Sections: Summary · Impact (who/how many/how long) · Timeline (detection → mitigation → resolution) · Root cause (systems, not people) · What went well · Action items (each with a clear owner-shaped ask). Factual, no speculation beyond the timeline.

chains.label: Postmortem → Tracked Action Items
chains.description: Extracts the action items from a postmortem and, after a human confirms scope, files each as a follow-up task so nothing falls through.

orgId.description: Org the action-item tasks belong to.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

config.systemPrompt: Extract every action item from this postmortem as a numbered list. Each item: a specific, verifiable task in one line. Ignore prose that isn't an action. Do not invent items.

config.title: Confirm the action items before filing tasks
